overview: 本期共收录 10 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、国际贸易（1 篇）、资产定价（1 篇）。方法上以双重差分、模型校准为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（5 篇）、NBER（3 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 3 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Representation learning in diffusion and flow-based model: an application aspect
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Diffusion models and flow-based models have recently become the dominant paradigms in generative modeling, largely due to their ability to learn rich, multi-level visual representations through large-scale training. This creates a bidirectional relationship between generative models and representation learning: improving representation learning enhances generation quality, while the learned representations can be leveraged for broader understanding tasks. This survey systematically explores this interplay with a focus on applications. We propose a three-tier progressive framework that organizes existing works from three perspectives: using representation learning to improve generative capabilities, exploiting generative models to extract representations for perception tasks, and ultimately moving toward general-purpose unified applications. We systematically categorize representative methods across a wide range of downstream tasks, including image classification, dense visual prediction, instance-level perception, and annotation-scarce scenarios. By providing a unified taxonomy and identifying key challenges, this survey aims to clarify the underlying logic of current research and suggest promising directions for future exploration. We hope this work can serve as a valuable reference for researchers interested in harnessing the representation power of generative models for applications beyond generation.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
近年来，扩散模型和基于流的模型已成为生成式建模领域的主流范式，这主要归功于它们通过大规模训练能够学习到丰富、多层次的视觉表征。这种机制在生成模型与表征学习之间建立了双向互动关系：提升表征学习能力能够改善生成质量，而学习到的表征又可以用于更广泛的认知任务。本综述系统地探讨了这种互动关系，重点关注相关应用。我们提出了一个三层渐进式框架，从三个角度对现有研究进行梳理：利用表征学习提升生成能力、借助生成模型提取用于感知任务的表征，以及最终实现通用化的统一应用。我们系统地将各种方法分类到包括图像分类、密集视觉预测、实例级感知以及数据稀缺场景在内的多种下游任务中。通过提供统一的分类体系并识别关键挑战，本综述旨在阐明当前研究的逻辑基础，并为未来的研究方向提出建议。我们希望这项工作能为那些希望将生成模型的表征能力应用于生成之外的领域的研究人员提供有价值的参考。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: The impact of agricultural tourism integration on farmers’ income growth: empirical evidence from China
papers.abstract:
Introduction
                    Agritourism is widely regarded as a practical approach to rural economic restructuring and income diversification in developing economies. This study evaluates the income effect of China’s National Demonstration Counties for Leisure Agriculture and Rural Tourism (LART) program and examines heterogeneity and potential transmission channels.
                  
                  
                    Methods
                    Using a balanced panel of 1,532 Chinese county-level administrative units from 2000 to 2023, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences design. We further examine heterogeneity across geographical regions, city sizes, and high-speed-rail accessibility, and assess associations with capital-attraction and ecological-quality proxies.
                  
                  
                    Results
                    In the preferred specification, LART designation is associated with a 0.099-log-point increase in rural residents’ per capita disposable income (standard error = 0.024), equivalent to approximately 10.4%. The estimated association is larger in western China and small cities. LART designation is also positively associated with the selected capital and ecological proxies, although these regressions do not establish formal mediation.
                  
                  
                    Discussion
                    The findings suggest that agritourism-oriented place-based policies can support rural income growth, particularly in less-developed areas. The channel results should be interpreted as exploratory evidence, and the external validity of the estimates is bounded by China’s institutional and tourism-market context.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】引言  
农业旅游被广泛认为是发展中国家实现农村经济结构调整和收入多元化的一种有效途径。本研究评估了中国“休闲农业与农村旅游国家示范县”（LART）计划对收入的影响，并探讨了其中的异质性及潜在传导机制。  

方法  
我们使用了2000年至2023年间中国1,532个县级行政单位的平衡面板数据，采用了交错差分设计（staggered difference-in-differences approach）。同时，我们还分析了不同地理区域、城市规模以及高铁可达性等因素的异质性，并评估了这些因素与资本吸引力和生态质量指标之间的关联。  

结果  
在首选的模型设定中，获得LART示范县称号的农村居民人均可支配收入增加了0.099个对数单位（标准误差为0.024），相当于约10.4%。这一效应在中国西部及小城市中更为显著。LART称号与选定的资本和生态质量指标也存在正相关关系，尽管这些回归分析并未确立明确的中介效应。  

讨论  
研究结果表明，以农业旅游为导向的地方性政策能够促进农村收入增长，尤其是在欠发达地区。然而，这些研究结果应被视为探索性证据，其外部有效性受到中国制度背景和...。研究方法：双重差分、回归分析。

papers.title: Business Logic as an Integrated Corporate Governance Mechanism under Uncertainty
papers.abstract: Contemporary corporate governance operates in an environment shaped by digital transformation, geopolitical instability, increasing uncertainty, and stronger expectations regarding transparency and stakeholder accountability. These conditions require an integrated approach that connects strategic decision-making, stakeholder interests, risk management, and long-term value creation. This study aims to develop a conceptual model of business logic as an integrated corporate governance mechanism under uncertainty and to determine its theoretical foundations, structural dimensions, and practical significance. The methodology is based on an interdisciplinary theoretical framework combining stakeholder theory, institutional theory, dynamic capabilities, systems thinking, and contemporary corporate governance principles. The study applies analysis and synthesis to generalize existing approaches, comparative analysis to identify their limitations, and conceptual modelling to construct an original three-dimensional framework. The results define business logic as an integrated system of principles, patterns, and managerial mechanisms that aligns stakeholder interests, organizational resources, and external environmental requirements in strategic decision-making. The proposed model integrates three interrelated dimensions, namely managerial, stakeholder, and value dimensions, across six sequential phases of corporate transformation: entropy, nonlinear transformation, divergence, bifurcation, convergence, and formation of a new system. The model links strategic adaptation with risk management, stakeholder engagement, ESG principles, and corporate value creation. Its practical application can support the transition from reactive to preventive risk management, strengthen organizational adaptability and stakeholder trust, and improve the consistency of corporate decisions under uncertainty. The study concludes that business logic can serve as a theoretical and practical framework for continuous corporate transformation. Further research should empirically test the model across industries and develop indicators for assessing transformation phases and their effects on organizational resilience, governance effectiveness, and long-term corporate value.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】当代企业治理所处的环境受到数字化转型、地缘政治不稳定、不确定性增加以及对透明度和利益相关者责任要求的提高等多重因素的影响。这些因素要求企业采取一种综合性的治理方式，将战略决策、利益相关者诉求、风险管理以及长期价值创造有机结合起来。本研究旨在构建一个概念模型，以阐释在不确定性环境下企业治理的逻辑机制，并明确其理论基础、结构特征及实际意义。研究方法基于跨学科的理论框架，融合了利益相关者理论、制度理论、动态能力理论、系统思维以及当代企业治理原则。通过分析综合现有研究方法，运用比较分析揭示其局限性，并通过概念建模构建了一个三维框架。

该模型将“商业逻辑”定义为一种综合性的体系，它包含一系列原则、模式和管理机制，能够在战略决策过程中协调利益相关者的诉求、组织资源与外部环境要求。所提出的模型涵盖了企业转型的六个连续阶段：熵增阶段、非线性转型阶段、分歧阶段、分岔阶段、收敛阶段以及新系统的形成阶段，并将战略调整与风险管理、利益相关者参与、ESG（环境、社会、治理）原则及企业价值创造紧密联系起来。该模型的实际应用有助于企业从被动的风险管理方式转向主动的预防性风险管理，提升组织的适应能力和利益相关...。

papers.title: Financial Technology and Financial Inclusion in Rural Communities of Bayelsa State
papers.venue: SIAR-Global Journal of Economics Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract:
This study investigated what drives financial inclusion among rural dwellers in an emerging 
economy, motivated by the persistent financing and banking gap in communities that conventional 
banks struggle to reach. Four determinants were examined: mobile money and agent banking 
adoption, network and technological infrastructure, financial literacy and digital trust, and 
distance to the nearest financial access point. Because the exact population of rural dwellers in the 
study area was unknown, Cochran's formula was applied to arrive at a target sample of 380 
respondents, drawn through a multi-stage sampling technique from adult residents across the 
study communities using a structured instrument, with data analysed through relevant statistical 
tools. The analysis revealed that financial inclusion in the study area depends significantly on the 
four determinants deployed in the study. The study therefore concludes that financial inclusion in 
these rural communities is shaped jointly by the extent of Fintech adoption, the quality of network 
infrastructure, residents' financial literacy, and their proximity to a financial access point. It 
recommends that government and telecommunication companies extend network infrastructure 
into riverine communities, that Fintech operators design simple, low-literacy-friendly platforms, 
and that financial literacy programmes be delivered in local languages to build public participation 
and confidence in digital financial services.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究旨在探讨在新兴经济体中，哪些因素推动了农村居民的金融包容性。研究的动机在于：传统银行难以覆盖的社区普遍存在融资和银行服务方面的缺口。研究考察了四个关键决定因素：移动支付和代理银行服务的普及程度、网络与技术基础设施、金融素养以及人们对数字服务的信任程度，还有距离最近金融服务点的距离。由于研究区域内农村居民的具体人口数量未知，因此采用了Cochran公式来确定目标样本规模，最终通过多阶段抽样方法从各研究社区的成年居民中选取了380名受访者，并使用结构化问卷收集数据，随后通过相关统计工具对数据进行了分析。分析结果表明，该研究区域的金融包容性在很大程度上受到上述四个因素的影响。因此，研究得出结论：这些农村社区的金融包容性受到金融科技应用程度、网络基础设施质量、居民金融素养以及他们距离金融服务点的远近的共同作用。研究建议政府与电信企业将网络基础设施延伸至偏远地区；金融科技企业应开发简单易用的、适合低文化水平人群使用的平台；同时，应以当地语言开展金融素养培训项目，以增强公众对数字金融服务的参与度和信任度。。

papers.title: Crowding Out Temptation: Experimental Evidence on Savings and Health Behaviors in Kenya
papers.abstract:
Alcohol use, transactional sex, and gambling carry significant health and economic consequences. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in
Kenya to assess whether these behaviors could be altered with a savings intervention that provided lottery-based interest, goal-setting support, and
savings reminders. Over 24 months, the intervention increased formal savings and assets, financed primarily by lower spending on alcohol, transactional sex, and gambling. It also reduced hazardous drinking by 26 percent and intimate partner violence by 15 percent. HIV/STI incidence declined by 8 percent, though this was not statistically significant. Savings interventions can simultaneously boost financial security and change health behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】酒精使用、交易性行为和赌博会对健康和经济产生重大影响。我们在肯尼亚开展了一项随机对照试验，旨在评估通过提供基于彩票的利息回报、目标设定支持以及储蓄提醒等干预措施，是否能够改变这些不良行为。在24个月的时间里，该干预措施显著增加了人们的正式储蓄和资产，其主要资金来源是减少在酒精、交易性行为和赌博上的支出。此外，该干预措施还将危险饮酒行为减少了26%，亲密伴侣暴力行为减少了15%。虽然HIV/性传播感染（STI）的发病率下降了8%，但这一变化在统计学上并不显著。储蓄干预措施既能提升人们的财务安全，又能促使人们改变不良的健康行为。。研究方法：随机实验。

papers.title: A Framework for Integrating Climate Goals into Trade Agreements
papers.abstract: A critical tension in global governance is that trade agreements have evolved largely in isolation from climate policy. This paper shows that the two domains generate systematic cross-externalities: larger gains from trade are associated with greater climate externalities imposed on partners, while linking carbon taxes to trade agreements produces distributive externalities that undermine the balance of trade concessions. To address this tension, we present a framework to integrate harmonized carbon pricing into the WTO subject to institutional and political-feasibility constraints. We explore two linkage designs. The first is a centralized Climate Fund, where all members apply a common demand-side carbon tax and contribute a portion of the revenues to the fund, capped by fiscal constraints. The Fund then reallocates these contributions to balance the tax burden across countries, subject to informational constraints. Quantitative analysis shows that even a simple fund allocation rule can sustain a carbon price of $138 per ton of CO2, reducing global emissions by 54%. The main binding constraint is informational: knowing the precise incidence of the carbon tax across countries ex ante would raise the feasible price to $265. The second is a decentralized design without transfers. Each member meets a carbon tax revenue floor but retains full discretion over its mix of demand-side and supply-side taxes. Energy exporters choose supply-side taxes while energy importers opt for demand-side taxes. These choices organically balance the tax burden and yield a 47% reduction in global emissions, almost rivaling the centralized Climate Fund.
papers.summary_zh:
【国际贸易】全球治理中的一个关键矛盾在于，贸易协定在很大程度上是独立于气候政策发展的。本文指出，这两个领域存在系统性的外部性：贸易带来的收益越大，对贸易伙伴造成的气候负面影响也越严重；而将碳税与贸易协定相结合则会引发分配性外部性，从而破坏贸易让步的平衡。为了解决这一矛盾，我们提出了一个框架，旨在将统一的碳定价机制纳入世界贸易组织（WTO）的体系之中，同时考虑制度性和政治可行性因素的限制。我们探讨了两种具体的联动机制设计。

第一种是集中式气候基金机制：所有成员国统一征收需求侧的碳税，并将部分税收收入纳入该基金，具体金额受到财政限制的约束。该基金随后根据信息限制重新分配这些收入，以实现各国之间的税收负担平衡。定量分析表明，即使采用简单的资金分配规则，也能维持每吨二氧化碳138美元的碳价，从而减少全球54%的碳排放。主要的制约因素在于信息获取：如果能够预先准确了解碳税在各国的具体影响程度，那么可行的碳价将上升至每吨265美元。

第二种是分散式机制，不涉及资金转移：各国只需达到最低碳税收入标准，但可以完全自主决定采取需求侧或供给侧的税收措施。能源出口国倾向于选择供给侧税收，而能源进口国则偏好需求...。

papers.title: A primary care-oriented framework for osteoporosis prediction: integrating multi-algorithm feature selection and machine learning model benchmarking
papers.abstract:
Summary
                    Large-scale screening and primary care diagnosis of osteoporosis are challenging due to the limited availability of dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA). Therefore, predictive models for osteoporosis that do not rely on bone mineral density measurements are essential. Using routine health examination data and applying a consensus feature selection strategy, we constructed machine learning (ML)-based models and compared their performance across multiple dimensions.
                  
                  
                    Purpose
                    To develop a robust, low-cost, and interpretable framework for osteoporosis prediction based on readily available information, which can be easily integrated into electronic health systems to inform DXA referral in resource-limited settings.
                  
                  
                    Methods
                    Variables covered by the basic health examination package were obtained from participants who underwent health examinations between January 2024 and January 2025. We implemented a strategy in which only features selected by at least four out of the seven feature selection methods were retained. Six ML algorithms were employed to develop models, and their prediction performances were compared across discrimination, goodness-of-fit, and clinical utility.
                  
                  
                    Results
                    A total of 2,260 participants were included, with an osteoporosis prevalence of 7.1%. Eight features: age, sex, body mass index, alkaline phosphatase, hematocrit, high-density lipoprotein, urea, and platelet count, were selected for model development. In the validation set, the random forest and artificial neural network (ANN) models demonstrated strongest screening performance, with AUCs of 0.895 (95% CI 0.867–0.923) and 0.890 (95% CI 0.862–0.919), respectively. The ANN model additionally exhibited superior calibration. Shapley additive explanations were applied to interpret the ANN model for osteoporosis prediction.
                  
                  
                    Conclusion
                    This study presents an easily integrable model for osteoporosis prediction based on routine health examination data. The ANN model provides robust prediction, offering a potential tool for pre-DXA triage and early identification of high-risk individuals in primary care and resource-limited settings.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**摘要**  
由于双能X射线吸收测定法（DXA）的可用性有限，大规模筛查和初级保健中的骨质疏松症诊断面临诸多挑战。因此，开发不依赖于骨密度测量的骨质疏松症预测模型至关重要。本研究利用常规健康检查数据，并采用共识特征选择策略，构建了基于机器学习（ML）的预测模型，并从多个维度评估了这些模型的性能。

**目的**  
旨在基于易于获取的信息，开发一种稳健、低成本且易于解释的骨质疏松症预测框架，以便在资源有限的环境中将其集成到电子健康系统中，为DXA检查提供决策依据。

**方法**  
研究数据来自2024年1月至2025年1月期间接受健康检查的参与者。我们采用了一种特征选择策略：仅保留至少被七种特征选择方法中的四种选中的特征。共使用了六种机器学习算法来构建预测模型，并从区分能力、拟合优度和临床实用性三个方面评估了这些模型的性能。

**结果**  
共有2,260名参与者参与了研究，其中骨质疏松症的患病率为7.1%。最终选定了八个特征用于模型构建：年龄、性别、体重指数、碱性磷酸酶、血细胞比容、高密度脂蛋白、尿素和血小板计数。在验证集中，随机森林模型和人工神经网络（ANN）模型...。研究方法：模型校准、机器学习、神经网络、随机森林。

papers.title: Reforming the EU Return Acquis through “Exceptionalized Pluralism”: From Internal Borders to Offshore Enforcement
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  The 2024–2026 reform of the EU return procedure constitutes the most far–reaching transformation of the European return acquis since the adoption of the key instrument governing returns—Directive 2008/115/EC. This Article critically assesses the impact of the reform on the EU return acquis and more generally on the migration regulatory framework. First, it introduces the concept of “exceptionalized pluralism” to describe the defining structural feature of the reform: the multiplication of derogatory return tracks—at external and internal EU borders and extraterritorially—that systematically displace the procedural safeguards constitutionalized by the Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU), progressively relegating the common return procedure from norm to residual exception. Second, it argues that this architecture raises constitutional concerns on four interconnected fronts: the codification of numerous accelerated border transfer procedures institutionalizing harmonization as the coordination of coercion rather than the harmonization of rights; the European Return Order reproducing the structural accountability gaps of the Dublin system; the systematic expansion of pre-removal detention recalibrating the constitutional relationship between the right to liberty and executive power beyond what Article 6 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU (CFR) and the CJEU permit; and the formalization of return externalization through “return hubs” raising rule of law and accountability issues. In conclusion, the Article argues that the legitimacy of the emerging European return system will depend not on its operational speed or uniformity, but on whether enforcement harmonization is matched by concrete implementation of Charter-based safeguards. Moreover, it warns that, absent such implementation, “exceptionalized pluralism” will continue to operate as a self-reinforcing regulatory logic, expanding its derogatory tracks and leaving courts to fulfill, under conditions of mounting institutional pressure, a constitutional function that the legislative design has failed to assume.
papers.summary_zh:
【资产定价】摘要  
2024–2026年欧盟遣返程序的改革是自《2008/115/EC指令》（该关键法规）颁布以来，欧洲遣返制度所经历的最深远变革。本文深入评估了这项改革对欧盟遣返制度乃至整个移民监管框架的影响。首先，本文引入了“例外化多元主义”（exceptionalized pluralism）的概念，用以描述改革的本质特征：即在欧盟外部和内部边境以及境外设立了大量例外性遣返途径，这些途径系统性地取代了欧洲法院（CJEU）所确立的程序性保障措施，逐步将统一的遣返程序降格为例外情况。其次，本文指出这一改革在四个相互关联的方面引发了宪法层面的担忧：一是大量加速边境移交程序的制度化，这些程序将协调机制视为强制手段而非权利保障的体现；二是《欧洲遣返令》（European Return Order）延续了都柏林体系中的结构性责任漏洞；三是遣返前拘留措施的系统性扩大，这超出了《欧盟基本权利宪章》（Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU）第6条及欧洲法院的授权范围，重新定义了自由权与行政权力之间的宪法关系；四是通过“遣返中心”（return hubs）将遣返职...。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Moderate-scale operation of family farms in China: underlying logic, practical constraints, and optimization pathways for sustainable food systems
papers.abstract: The transformation of sustainable food systems must reconcile production efficiency and supply resilience with the protection of smallholder livelihoods, and for economies with large populations and limited arable land this reconciliation rests heavily on how the scale of family-farm operation is understood and organized. The academic community has long held theoretical disagreements on this issue between static efficiency standards and dynamic equilibrium perspectives, and no integrated explanatory framework that combines economic logic, social context and temporal dimensions has yet been established. Drawing on new institutional economics, economic sociology, family life-cycle theory and intergenerational transmission theory, and proceeding through theoretical deduction, institutional context analysis and secondary evidence from policy documents, official statistics and literature, this paper develops a triple-constraint dynamic equilibrium framework for the moderate-scale operation of family farms in China; its purpose is explanatory rather than estimative, since no uniform optimal scale is defensible across heterogeneous regional endowments, crop systems, service conditions and family structures. The framework holds that moderate scale is not a fixed value set externally but a dynamic equilibrium interval of operating scale: the economic-efficiency constraint sets its lower bound, the social-embeddedness constraint sets its upper bound, and the intergenerational-sustainability constraint operates as an independent temporal condition that also moderates the position and width of the interval as the family life cycle and succession arrangements change. Seen thus, the factor-market, organisational-coordination and temporal-dimension failures observable in practice appear as three structural tensions that jointly compress the feasible interval and constrain the contribution of family farms to sustainable food-system goals. The contribution lies in bringing social embeddedness and intergenerational sustainability into the analysis of moderate scale, moving beyond a single-efficiency account and offering an integrated explanatory framework for the evolution of family-farm scale in transition economies with fragmented landholdings and household-centred production. The framework applies directly to family farms and other family-centred operations; its three constraints are analytically general, whereas their relative binding strength, the interval's position and the associated policy instruments remain conditional on the institutional environment, particularly China's collective land ownership and household contract responsibility system, so that its reference value for other transition economies is conditional rather than universal.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】可持续食品系统的转型必须兼顾生产效率与供应韧性，同时保护小农户的生计。对于人口众多但耕地有限的经济体而言，这种平衡在很大程度上取决于对家庭农场经营规模的认知和组织方式。学术界长期以来在这一问题上存在理论分歧，主要体现在静态效率标准与动态均衡视角之间的对立。目前尚未形成一个能够整合经济逻辑、社会背景和时间维度的综合解释框架。本文借鉴了新制度经济学、经济社会学、家庭生命周期理论以及代际传承理论，通过理论推导、制度环境分析以及政策文件、官方统计数据和文献的二手资料，构建了一个适用于中国中等规模家庭农场经营的动态均衡框架。该框架旨在提供解释性分析，而非进行精确的规模估算——因为在不同区域资源禀赋、作物系统、服务条件及家庭结构下，并不存在一个普遍适用的最优规模。框架认为，中等规模并非一个固定的数值，而是一个动态的运营范围：经济效率约束为其下限，社会嵌入性约束为其上限，代际可持续性约束则作为一个独立的时间因素，随着家庭生命周期和继承安排的变化而影响这一范围的位置和宽度。实践中观察到的要素市场失灵、组织协调问题及时间维度障碍实际上反映了三种结构性矛盾，这些矛盾共同压缩了家庭农场实现可持续食品系...。研究方法：文本分析、均衡模型。

papers.title: Does Food Assistance Drive Spending on Sugary Foods? Evidence from the Pandemic Electronic Benefit Transfer Program
papers.abstract: We provide evidence on the extent to which food assistance affects spending on sugary items by studying the Pandemic Electronic Benefit Transfer (P-EBT) program, which provided funds to families of children who lost access to free and reduced-price school meals due to COVID-19 pandemic school closures. Leveraging state-level variation in the timing of P-EBT disbursements using a stacked difference-in-differences identification strategy with NielsenIQ Consumer Panel data, we find that P-EBT disbursement was associated with a 16-percent increase in weekly spending on sugary items among SNAP-eligible households with school-aged children. Notably, this increase exceeded the percentage increase in overall food spending for this group, suggesting that SNAP-eligible households with school-aged children allocated a disproportionately large share of their P-EBT-driven purchases toward sugary items relative to their pre-period baseline. We do not detect changes among households unlikely to have received P-EBT benefits or in placebo disbursement years.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文研究食品援助项目（P-EBT）是否以及如何影响家庭对含糖食品的消费支出。

🔬 研究方法：利用NielsenIQ消费者面板数据，采用堆叠双重差分策略，基于P-EBT发放时间的州级差异进行识别。

📊 核心发现：研究发现P-EBT发放与SNAP资格家庭含糖食品周支出增加16%有关，且该增幅高于整体食品支出，表明资金被不成比例地用于含糖食品。

💡 应用价值：揭示了食品援助项目可能带来的健康风险，为政策制定者在设计福利分配机制时提供了重要参考。
